question: Related Questions Q. visiting makkah without ihram(no intension of umrah) 22618 views Q. missing tawaf round? 3153 views Q. going for haj will pray qasr or as muqeem? 8796 views Q. We want to go to perform umrah but i doubt that my wife may have Menstrual Cycles (Monthly Period)during that time. actually we can not avoid to go during those days. What is fatwa for this case? 3803 views Q. Umrah 1976 views Q. Is it valid to stitch below ihram cloth from one side just like closed lungi? 4914 views Q. I am living in Saudi Arabia. Can I perform more than one UMRAH in a same day when i go to umrah. and if i want to perform umrah for my grandfather who already passed it is valid. and also can i perform umrah for live people.if more than one umrah allowed than after each umrah i have to save my head.? please guide me. 8609 views Q. I wish to take my mother and wife for HAJJ . But I have some business problems and creditors to pay ( I am writing my problems below in detail) so I am not sure if MY HAJJ WILL BE IN ORDER . I am doing business in the family but due to some disputes our business is on closure and we have bank interest and creditors to pay. I want to settle all the creditors by selling our land to avoid the WRATH OF ALLAH SUBHANAHO TAALAH , but my other associates are not ready for this. As we are all blaming each other for the problems and nobody is interested in settling the business creditors / bank as they all want some money for themselves before they are ready to settle the accounts. The situation is not improving and I want to take my mother and wife for HAJJ with my own personal busines money . Can you please advice, in the light of the Shariat , am I allowed to perform the HAJJ in this situation and will it be in order ? May Allah give you the JAZAA for helping me in this matter. 1926 views Q. Hajj 2531 views Q. As salam alaikum, Respected ulama of deoband. My question is regarding umrah. I stay in KSA and i have commit a mistake during umrah i have to give (dum). until now i have not given dum is there any other option insted of dum. And what is the time to give the dum. please explain in detail in the light of quran and hadith. 3965 views Q. tawaf and intention 5392 views Q. Assalamu alaikum Mufti saab; i have a question regarding the UMRAH.i live in Riyadh. I went to makkah to perform UMRAH. I completed my UMRAH there and then went to Jeddah to see my relatives but while returnign i came back to Makkah and immediately got the bus to riyadh. Kindly please advice if i had to perform UMRAH since i came from Jeddah to board the bus in Makkah. If yes, then please advice what should i do now since i have not preformed the later UMRAH. 2873 views Q. Last year during HAJJ, a strange incident took place during my SAII of umrah. I had performed HAJJ-E-QIRAN. As i reached makkah at mid-night and we had to leave for MINA the next day, i decided to perform my umrah immediately without taking any rest. During my SAII, I started feeling very exhausted towards the end and i got confused with the count.After thinking over i was sure that i had completed all the 7 shawts of SAII BUT still as i did not want to take a chance i decided to continue from safa to marwa and back. As i walked towards marwah and crossed 30 percent distance i got so exhausted and sleepy that i was certain i would collapse. i was seeing safa and was worryig how i would walk upto safa and then back upto marwah. After a few seconds even before i could cross 50 percent distance towards safa i was forced to close my eyes and i thought i was going to fall. When i opened my eyes i was ascending marwah. I was amazed and did not know what happened. How coulf i have walked one and a half shawts of SAII without realizing anything. It all happened in a blink of my eye. PLEASE do the khulasa. 2397 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 51406 Country: India Title: mother -in-law can perform hajj with a son in law Question: My mother in law want to perform hajj this year she is 58 years old, her husband was death before 30 years, she have only two daughter, no son. Her brother and relatives now don't want to perform hajj and don't want to perform hajj with her. So can she perform hajj with son in law to take as a mahram. I am her elder daughter’s husband, so please send reply to me whether can she perform hajj with me? Answer ID: 51406 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 495/495/M=04/1435) In the case mentioned above, your mother in law can go with you to perform hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
